name: identity number
issuer: the Department of Home Affairs (its Director-General, in the population register)
note: The Identification Act 68 of 1997 (s 3, s 7, s 8) as gov.za holds it, and its government's own sheet on the OECD's automatic-exchange portal ('Information on Tax Identification Numbers'; the OECD's index page sits behind a bot check and wasn't opened, the sheet itself came straight back), read 2026-10-30: the Act applies to citizens and those lawfully and permanently resident; the Director-General assigns an identity number to everyone in the population register, made of the date of birth and gender, citizenship, a serial and a control number. The sheet: 13 digits YYMMDDSSSSCAZ, C being 0 for a citizen, 1 a permanent resident, 2 a refugee, and the last a checksum by the Luhn algorithm (the game's luhn). Read as given at birth (a birth registered with Home Affairs within 30 days enters the register); the identity document carrying it is issued from 16 and the first is free (ids engine). The A digit's meaning isn't stated. Used as the tax number (needed: tax); its other uses (a job, a driver's licence, banking) DHA lists as occasions to show the document, not modelled.
